answer_1.quote: Referring Expression Generation (REG) is a key aspect of Natural Language Generation (NLG) and a vital step in the classic Natural Language Generation pipeline...
answer_1.outputs: referring expressions (e.g., proper names, pronouns, descriptions)

answer_4.quote: We used the same set of items from the human evaluation experiment ... Each set of items was completed by 8 participants ... participants were asked to rate the text ... whether they agreed with the following three statements on a 7-point Likert-scale: (1) Clarity, (2) Grammaticality, (3) Coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated each paragraph on clarity, grammaticality, and coherence using a 7‑point Likert scale, and also performed referential‑success and rewriting tasks.
